messages.subject: For Andy Power | AI infrastructure, government relations and responsible data-center growth
messages.body:
Dear Digital Realty Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Andy Power, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Digital Realty's global expansion at the intersection of AI, cloud and data-center infrastructure increasingly depends on trusted relationships with governments, utilities, regulators and local communities. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Digital Realty's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Digital Realty.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
